releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.36 — no message can be lost again. Every send is written to a queue on the phone before it leaves (the same outbox the reference keeps in IndexedDB): if the network, the login token or the app itself drops mid-send, the message is retried automatically — at startup, whenever the realtime connection returns, and up to five times — and the server de-duplicates by client id so a retry can never post it twice. Messages still waiting are restored into the chat when you reopen it, even after a restart. Group chats now name every sender (member profiles are seeded instead of showing "NChat user") and read receipts turn your ticks blue when a member reads the group.
